Services for Forwarders
A nationwide feeder network that’s fast, flexible and reliable
Daylight offers domestic and international forwarders an expedited long-haul LTL feeder network that can get your shipments coast to coast in two days, at standard LTL rates. You can count on consistent service and rates, and our flexibility to customize solutions. We find ways to say yes.
Domestic shipments: a better option
When you want to offer 2- or 3-day service for long-haul LTL shipments, Daylight gives you a better option with no surprises. Our unique business model, with direct loading and non-stop two-driver teams, get your shipments there faster and more safely at standard LTL rates. Every time. Be more competitive, consistently.
International shipments: make earlier sailings on every coast
Promise your customers earlier sailings, and deliver on your promises. Use Daylight’s linehaul network as your feeder system for shipments heading out of Miami or Houston to South America, the East Coast for Europe, or Los Angeles, Long Beach, Oakland and Tacoma for Asia. Nobody’s faster, at standard LTL rates. We’re the alternative you can trust.
